subject: POC playbook scheduling + runbook for routing & load tests
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@atlasanalytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 3 Aug 2025 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: POC playbook: proposed dates & agenda outline

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the quick sync last week. Based on your goals (prompt fidelity, routing tiers, and a short load validation) we pulled together a suggested format for the POC kickoff + hands-on working sessions. High level: a 90-minute kickoff (intro + success criteria), two 3-hour hands-on blocks (prompt review + routing policy design; load tests + fallback validation), and a short async follow-up for model tuning recommendations.

Proposed windows (pick one):
- Option A: Tue/Wed Aug 12–13 (PST mornings, 9:30–13:00) — single-day split into two blocks
- Option B: Mon/Tue Aug 18–19 (PST afternoons, 13:00–17:00) — gives your infra team time to provision test harness

Prework we need from your side:
- 5 representative prompt templates (anonymized)
- Expected traffic profile for the load run (RT/s and concurrent sessions)
- Names of any additional stakeholders for model selection & security review

I attached a draft agenda (redwood_poc_agenda_v1.pdf) and a short runbook stub for the load test. I’m CC’ing Marcus (technical lead) and Priyom (solutions engineer) so they can confirm capacity/resourcing.

Would either of those windows work? If not, send a couple alternatives and we’ll adapt.

—Kimberly Park
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood_poc_agenda_v1.pdf (1 page, agenda)
From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@atlasanalytics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Anna Gomez <anna.gomez@atlasanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC playbook: proposed dates & agenda outline

Hi Kimberly —

Appreciate the outline. We’re excited to get into the routing policy part — couple quick clarifying Qs before we lock dates:
1) For the load run, will Redwood provide the actual test harness (load generator) or do we run it from our side?
2) For model selection: can you include a short session on quantization/latency tradeoffs? Our infra lead (Anna) will want to understand implications for on-prem vs cloud tiers.

Option A looks tight for our team; Option B is preferable but we need to confirm Samantha (security) is available. I’ve looped Anna for the infra timing.

Jordan
Director of Product
Atlas Analytics
jordan.ellis@atlasanalytics.com

---
Forwarded: I’ll also add Samantha once I check her calendar.
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@atlasanalytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Aug 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC playbook: proposed dates & agenda outline

Jordan —

Great questions. Short answers up front:
- Load harness: Redwood will provide a hosted load driver + a lightweight client script you can run inside your network (we’ll coordinate connection details). The loadtest_instructions.xlsx attached has the workflow.
- Quantization/latency: yes — we’ll include a 30-minute block in the model-selection segment to show measured latency deltas across float16/8-bit dynamic quantization on our dedicated tier. We’ll also note implications for on-prem images.

Updated plan:
- Kickoff (90m): goals, success metrics, data handling & security touchpoints (we’ll invite Samantha for this).
- Block A (3h): prompt review + routing policy design (model mapping, tiering, region routing, fallback rules)
- Block B (3h): load execution + KV/prefix cache validation + failure/fallback rehearsals

Marcus / Priyom — can you confirm we can reserve a burst slot on Dedicated for the load run on Aug 18 afternoon (US-PST)? Also flag any pre-provision steps for Atlas on VPN or test keys.

I’ve added a shared Drive folder for prework: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4d5E_poc-playbook. If you can drop prompt samples there we’ll review them before the session.

Thanks —
Kimberly

Attachment: loadtest_instructions.xlsx (spreadsheet, steps + sample commands)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Aug 2025 08:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC playbook: proposed dates & agenda outline

Kimberly / team —

Confirmed: we can allocate a Dedicated burst slot for Aug 18 (14:00–17:00 PST). Priyom, I’ll hand you the capacity keys — please coordinate with Atlas for test keys and VPN ACLs.

Note for the session: I’ll bring a short notebook demo comparing float16 vs 8-bit quantization on the M60-series; we should timebox it to 30 minutes. Also recommend we reserve a 30-minute follow-up (async) to capture model tuning notes.

–Marcus
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@atlasanalytics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Anna Gomez <anna.gomez@atlasanalytics.com>, Samantha Park <samantha.park@atlasanalytics.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Aug 2025 10:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC playbook: proposed dates & agenda outline

Thanks everyone — Aug 18 works for us. I’ve CC’d Samantha (Security) and Anna (Infra). Two asks before kickoff: 1) Could you surface a short evidence runbook for the load run (what logs we’ll capture, retention expectations, and who owns what)? 2) Please add a short line in the agenda to cover fallback SLAs (e.g., when to drop to a cheaper variant vs route to another region).

If you can drop the runbook and a calendar invite, we’ll lock it.

Jordan
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@atlasanalytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Samantha Park <samantha.park@atlasanalytics.com>, Anna Gomez <anna.gomez@atlasanalytics.com>
Date: Sun, 10 Aug 2025 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC playbook: proposed dates & agenda outline

Jordan / Anna / Samantha —

Locked in: Aug 18, 13:00–17:00 PST (kickoff + Block A) and Aug 19, 09:30–12:30 PST (Block B). I’ve created the calendar event and shared the agenda + runbook stubs. Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-atlas-poc-aug10 (accept to add to your calendars).

Deliverables I attached: SOW stub for the POC (sow_stub.docx), finalized agenda (redwood_poc_agenda_v1.pdf updated), and the load test instructions (loadtest_instructions.xlsx). The runbook summary (short) is also at: https://docs.redwood.com/runbooks/poc-routing-runbook — it lists logs we’ll collect (token-level latency, KV hit rate, error traces), retention (30 days by default for the POC), and ownership columns.

Action items before Aug 18:
- Atlas: drop 5 anonymized prompt examples in the Drive folder.
- Atlas Infra: confirm VPN/test key access for the load client.
- Redwood: send meeting invites and reserve Dedicated burst slot (Marcus).

If anything changes I’ll update the event. Looking forward to it.

Best —
Kimberly Park
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachments: sow_stub.docx; redwood_poc_agenda_v1.pdf; loadtest_instructions.xlsx
